sub_breakpoints.name: ACTOR_MATRIX_NOT_EXPANDED
sub_breakpoints.description: Planner generates role-level mutations but does not expand to specific actor combinations: cross-tenant pairs, resource-owner vs non-owner, uploader vs other user

sub_breakpoints.name: STATE_PATH_NOT_EXPLORED
sub_breakpoints.description: Planner generates abstract state/precondition mutations but does not plan concrete multi-step sequences to reach forbidden source states or precondition states before executing target operation

sub_breakpoints.name: CROSS_ENTITY_OPERATION_CHAIN_NOT_BUILT
sub_breakpoints.description: Planner treats operations as single-entity; does not build multi-entity execution chains using bound relations (e.g., create SLA → create ticket with SLA ref → update SLA)

sub_breakpoints.name: IDEMPOTENCY_REPETITION_NOT_GENERATED
sub_breakpoints.description: IDEMPOTENCY mechanism generates abstract first/repeat mutation descriptors but does not produce concrete executable two-step sequence (execute → repeat same request)

planning_funnel_summary.note: 14 targets never generated experiment candidates despite having correct mechanisms. Loss is in template generation completeness, not in dedup/budget/risk.
